title: Binary Search
statement: Read n, a sorted array, and target x. Print the zero-based index of an occurrence of x, or -1 if absent.
inputFormat: Line 1: n. Line 2: sorted n integers. Line 3: x.
hints: Study how the sample input is transformed into the sample output.
Try a small case manually and identify the operation or rule.
Test an edge case before submitting.
editorial:
Parse the input in the given order, apply the operation described by the examples, and print the result.

```
n=int(input()); a=list(map(int,input().split())); x=int(input()); l=0; r=n-1; ans=-1
while l<=r:
 m=(l+r)//2
 if a[m]==x: ans=m; break
 if a[m]<x: l=m+1
 else: r=m-1
print(ans)
```
reference:
n=int(input()); a=list(map(int,input().split())); x=int(input()); l=0; r=n-1; ans=-1
while l<=r:
 m=(l+r)//2
 if a[m]==x: ans=m; break
 if a[m]<x: l=m+1
 else: r=m-1
print(ans)

title: Two Sum Exists
statement: Read n, an array, and target t. Print YES if two different positions contain values that sum to t; otherwise print NO.


title: Maximum Subarray Sum
